papers.title: The Direct Anterior Approach for 1-Stage Bilateral Total Hip Arthroplasty: Early Outcome Analysis of a Single-Surgeon Case Series
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Rutgers-Robert Wood Johnson Medical School, Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital, New Brunswick, New Jersey

corresponding_authors.name: Bertrand W. Parcells
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Rutgers-Robert Wood Johnson Medical School, Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital, New Brunswick, New Jersey

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床病例系列，报告直接前入路一期双侧全髋置换术的早期结果，未涉及生物力学建模或植入物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: No quantification of stress shielding, micromotion, or bone remodeling; no FEA or contact mechanics; purely clinical outcomes.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估直接前入路一期双侧全髋置换术的早期临床效果和安全性。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析单术者连续病例的临床资料和随访结果。
summary_zh.result: 早期结果良好，并发症率低，功能恢复满意。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床随访和影像学评估，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate early clinical outcomes and safety of single-stage bilateral total hip arthroplasty via the direct anterior approach.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of consecutive cases by a single surgeon, including clinical and radiographic follow-up.
summary_en.result: Early results showed good functional recovery and low complication rates.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up and radiographic assessment without experimental validation.

papers.title: Identification of parameters of selective laser melting process of the CoCr alloy on the basis of assorted parameters of topography of a surface after milling
papers.abstract: Artyku prezentuje przebieg i wyniki bada nad okreleniem zalenoci pomidzy parametrami procesu selektywnego stapiania laserowego SLM (selective laser melting) stopu CoCr a wybranymi parametrami topografii powierzchni po frezowaniu. Stop CoCr jest materiaem szeroko wykorzystywanym w medycynie, a zwaszcza w dentystyce i protetyce. Jest powszechnie stosowany w technologiach przyrostowych, takich jak selektywne stapianie laserowe, i pozwala na wytwarzanie elementw o niemal dowolnie zoonej geometrii. Powstae w ten sposb np. implanty mona w bardzo wysokim stopniu spersonalizowa. Wanym aspektem jes rwnie brak koniecznoci stosowania dodatkowego oprzyrzdowania technologicznego, ktre znacznie podwysza koszt produkcji jednostkowej, jak jest wytwarzanie spersonalizowanych implantw medycznych. Jedn z najwikszych wad technologii SLM jest wysoka chropowato surowej powierzchni oraz niedostateczna dokadno wymiarowo-ksztatowa

corresponding_authors.name: Dariusz Grzesiak
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Zachodniopomorski Uniwersytet Technologiczny w Szczecinie, Instytut Technologii Mechanicznej, ul. Piastów 19, 70-310 Szczecin

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅研究CoCr合金SLM加工后铣削表面形貌参数，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合等生物力学核心问题。
llm.why_not_core: No connection to stress shielding or stiffness matching, no porous structure design, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM参数与铣削后表面形貌参数的关系
summary_zh.method: 实验测量不同SLM参数下CoCr合金铣削后的表面形貌参数
summary_zh.result: 发现SLM参数显著影响铣削后表面粗糙度等形貌特征
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量数据验证参数关系

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the relationship between selective laser melting process parameters and the surface topography of CoCr alloy after milling.
summary_en.method: Experimental measurement of surface topography parameters (e.g., roughness) after milling of CoCr samples fabricated with different SLM parameters.
summary_en.result: SLM parameters significantly influence the surface roughness and other topographical features after subsequent milling.
summary_en.validation: Empirical verification through direct measurement of surface topography.

papers.title: Primary vs Conversion Total Hip Arthroplasty: A Cost Analysis
papers.first_author_affiliation: University of California Irvine Medical School, Irvine, California

corresponding_authors.name: Ran Schwarzkopf
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Division of Adult Reconstruction, Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, NYU Hospital for Joint Diseases, NYU Langone Medical Center, New York, New York

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅分析全髋关节置换术的成本，未涉及任何生物力学或植入物设计内容。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a cost analysis study with no biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding quantification, no micromotion analysis, and no implant design or FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较初次与转换全髋关节置换术的成本差异。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析患者数据，计算直接医疗成本。
summary_zh.result: 转换THA成本显著高于初次THA。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the direct medical costs between primary and conversion total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of patient data to calculate direct healthcare costs.
summary_en.result: Conversion THA is significantly more expensive than primary THA.

papers.title: Preoperative Joint Space Width Predicts Patient-Reported Outcomes After Total Hip Arthroplasty in Young Patients
papers.first_author_affiliation: Washington University School of Medicine, Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, St Louis, Missouri

corresponding_authors.name: Jeffrey B. Stambough
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Washington University School of Medicine, Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, St Louis, Missouri

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究术前关节间隙宽度对年轻患者全髋关节置换术后患者报告结局的预测作用，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify femoral stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical modeling; it is purely clinical outcome prediction without implant mechanics or FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究术前关节间隙宽度能否预测年轻THA患者的术后结局。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析术前关节间隙宽度与术后患者报告结局的关系。
summary_zh.result: 术前关节间隙宽度与术后结局显著相关。
summary_zh.validation: 临床患者数据统计分析。

summary_en.motivation: To determine whether preoperative joint space width predicts patient-reported outcomes after total hip arthroplasty in young patients.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of the association between preoperative joint space width and postoperative patient-reported outcome measures.
summary_en.result: Preoperative joint space width was significantly associated with postoperative outcomes.
summary_en.validation: Statistical analysis of clinical patient data.

papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Zuyderland Medical Centre, Sittard-Geleen, the Netherlands

corresponding_authors.name: Luc J.M. Heijnens
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Zuyderland Medical Centre, Sittard-Geleen, the Netherlands

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文报告了全髋关节置换术的临床结果，但未涉及生物力学建模或应力遮挡分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper reports clinical outcomes of cemented hip arthroplasty but does not include any biomechanical modeling, stress shielding quantification, micromotion analysis, or finite element simulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估骨水泥型解剖适应型全髋关节置换术的临床效果
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析患者术后功能评分和影像学结果
summary_zh.result: 该假体在中期随访中显示出良好的临床和影像学结果
summary_zh.validation: 基于患者临床随访数据

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the clinical and radiographic outcomes of a cemented anatomically adapted total hip arthroplasty design.
summary_en.method: A retrospective review of patient functional scores and radiographic findings at mid-term follow-up.
summary_en.result: The prosthesis demonstrated satisfactory clinical and radiographic outcomes with low complication rates.
